TextContext.SourceString: （距离观影会后过了一个星期。收到了星绘发来的信息。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It's been a week since the movie festival, I receive a text message from Celestia.)

TextContext.SourceString: ——天文观测活动就在今晚。这边已经什么都准备了！前辈只要记得把自己带上就好哦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The stargazing event is happening tonight! I've got everything prepared. Just make sure to show up, okay?

TextContext.SourceString: （简短的信息中，透露着星绘轻松和兴奋的心情，甚至还开起了小玩笑。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A brief message that radiates Celestia's carefree excitement, with a hint of playfulness.)

TextContext.SourceString: （带着期待的心情走进星庇所。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (With eager anticipation, I enter Astral Sanctuary.)

TextContext.SourceString: （下班！）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Clocking out!)

TextContext.SourceString: （去休息室与星绘见面，发现她的脸上蒙了一层阴影。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I head to the lounge to meet Celestia, only to find her looking rather gloomy.)

TextContext.SourceString: （就像……窗外阴云密布的天空那样？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Just like... the overcast sky outside?)

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈，晚上好……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Good evening, Navigator...

TextContext.SourceString: ……您说，我看起来很没精神的样子？
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Are you saying I look a bit down?

TextContext.SourceString: 是嘛……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is that so...

TextContext.SourceString: ……我懂的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...I understand.

TextContext.SourceString: 是啊，前辈会懂的……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yea, you always do...

TextContext.SourceString: 渐渐看不到星星了呢……
TextContext.LocalizedString: The stars are disappearing...

TextContext.SourceString: 毕竟准备了很久……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Especially after all your planning...

TextContext.SourceString: 是啊。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yea...

TextContext.SourceString: ……要是有天气控制器什么的，该有多好啊。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...If only we had a weather controller or something.

TextContext.SourceString: （第一次见到这样遭受打击的星绘，一时间不知道该如何是好。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Seeing Celestia this defeated for the first time, I have no clue how to comfort her.)

TextContext.SourceString: （就没有什么办法能够解决眼前状况了吗？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Is there truly no way to turn this situation around?)
Ah...

TextContext.SourceString: 抱歉，我、我不该这样的，明明还有更重要的工作要去做……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sorry, I shouldn't be like this, especially when there's more important work to be done...

TextContext.SourceString: 对了！之前和大家也说了要举办天文观测活动的事。如果不赶快通知的话，大家就要白跑一趟了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh right! I told everyone about the stargazing event. If we don't notify them promptly, they’ll be heading here in vain...

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈，我们可能得赶紧联络——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator, we may need to contact everyone quickly—

TextContext.SourceString: ……前辈？您，您怎么了？为什么一直在盯着地图看——
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Navigator? A-Are you okay? Why are you staring at the map?

TextContext.SourceString: （目光越过星绘的肩头，看到电脑屏幕上显示着星庇所附近的地图。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I glance over Celestia’s shoulder at the computer displaying a map of the area around Astral Sanctuary.)

TextContext.SourceString: ——明天有烟花大会，海滩上会来很多游客，你们可别把位置占太久咯。
TextContext.LocalizedString: A fireworks display will take place tomorrow. We're expecting a lot of tourists. Don't occupy this spot for too long.

TextContext.SourceString: 大海
TextContext.LocalizedString: The sea.

TextContext.SourceString: 大、大海？前辈的意思是，把活动改为在海边举行？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Th-the sea? Are you suggesting we move the event to the beach?

TextContext.SourceString: 可是格兰德海滩离这里不远，天气肯定也不会有什么不一样——
TextContext.LocalizedString: But Grand Beach is not far from here. The weather probably won't be different...

TextContext.SourceString: 烟花
TextContext.LocalizedString: Fireworks.

TextContext.SourceString: 烟花？前辈是想把活动改为放烟花？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Fireworks? Are you thinking of changing the event to a fireworks show?

TextContext.SourceString: ……可是我也只有电子烟花棒什么的，离大家的期待也太远了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...But I've only got electric sparklers. They are far from everyone's expectations...

TextContext.SourceString: 来不及解释了，立刻通知大家改去海滩！
TextContext.LocalizedString: No time to explain, notify everyone to head to the beach!

TextContext.SourceString: 诶？前、前辈，到底是怎么回事——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Eh? W-What's going on, Navigator?

TextContext.SourceString: （朝星绘投去坚定的目光。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I give Celestia a look filled with determination.)

TextContext.SourceString: 既然前辈的眼神这样坚定的话……我知道了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you're that sure about it... alright.

TextContext.SourceString: 我把参加活动的大家的联系方式传给您，我们一起通知大家改换场地的事吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'll forward the contact details of all the participants. Let's notify them together about the change of venue.

TextContext.SourceString: （紧急联络了参加活动的众人，并在星庇所门前的电子板留下了活动场地转移的公告。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (We urgently contact the participants and leave a notice of the change of venue on the electronic noticeboard at Astral Sanctuary.)

TextContext.SourceString: （随后拉着星绘的手，一起奔向格兰德海滩。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Holding hands, Celestia and I rush to Grand Beach.)

TextContext.SourceString: （来到海滩，已经有很多人聚集在这里了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Arriving at the beach, we find a large crowd.)

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈，海滩边有好多人呢……
TextContext.LocalizedString: There are a lot of people here, Navigator...

TextContext.SourceString: 究竟是要举办什么活动——
TextContext.LocalizedString: What exactly are we doing...

TextContext.SourceString: （星绘的话还没有说完，一声“爆炸”吓了星绘一大跳。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Before Celestia finishes her sentence,  a "boom" startles her.)

TextContext.SourceString: （当高空烟花的绚烂色彩映照她的面容那一瞬间……已经不需要再进行过多的说明了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The brilliant colors of the fireworks light up her face... No further explanation is needed.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在四周的欢呼和赞叹声中，那个一直以来都在为他人着想的女孩，这一次也为自己露出了笑容吧。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Amidst joyful cheers, the girl who has always put others before herself finally smiles heartily.)

TextContext.SourceString: 烟花，好美……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Such beautiful fireworks...

TextContext.SourceString: 原来，原来就在我消沉的时候，前辈已经替我找到了更灿烂的“星星”。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It seems that while I was feeling down, you had already found a more radiant 'star' for me.

TextContext.SourceString: 能遇到前辈，真是太好了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I’m so glad to have met you...

TextContext.SourceString: 真希望这个夜晚，就停留在这一刻……您也会这样想吗，前辈？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I truly wish this night could last forever... Wouldn't you agree?...

TextContext.SourceString: （是的。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Yes.)

TextContext.SourceString: （愿今夜永不结束。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (May this night never end.)

TextContext.SourceString: （工作中的老旧电影放映机，发出吱吱嘎嘎的响声。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The old film projector clatters as it churns through the reels.)

TextContext.SourceString: （欢呼、呐喊、喧嚣，伴随着战争机器的轰鸣，久久回荡在我和星绘的耳畔。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Cheers, shouts, and clamors accompany the roar of war machines, echoing in Celestia's and my ears.)

TextContext.SourceString: ——“历经惨烈的战火之后，和平回到了这个世界上。”
TextContext.LocalizedString: “As the devastating war comes to an end, peace returns to this world.”

TextContext.SourceString: ——“不同种族，不同信仰的人们，都能和平地生活在一起，去建成一个崭新的世界。”
TextContext.LocalizedString: “People of different races and faiths live together in peace, building a brave new world.”

TextContext.SourceString: ——“在那个世界里，人们都会尊重彼此的生命和尊严，而任何野蛮的暴行和恐怖都会被禁止，任何侵略战争，都不再会发生。”
TextContext.LocalizedString: "In such a world, every life is respected, and brutal acts and terror are outlawed. War and aggression are things of the past.”

TextContext.SourceString: ——“在那个世界里，地球上的每一个人，都是朋友。”
TextContext.LocalizedString: “A world where all citizens of Earth are friends with one another.”

TextContext.SourceString: （迎着夕阳，士兵们抛下武器，孩童们回归家园。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (In the setting sun, soldiers lay down their weapons and children return to their homes.)

TextContext.SourceString: （大战过后，人们祈求着未来永久和平，期盼未来的人类能够做的比前人更好。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After the war, people pray for everlasting peace, hoping that future generations can maintain it better than their forefathers.)

TextContext.SourceString: （……时至今日，这些愿望从未被实现过。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (To this day, those wishes remain unfulfilled.)

TextContext.SourceString: （应星绘的邀请，前往格兰德海滩，参加星庇所举办的露天电影节。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Celestia has invited me to attend Astral Sanctuary's open-air film festival at Grand Beach.)

TextContext.SourceString: （因为不熟悉方向，就询问了附近的海滩巡逻员。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Unfamiliar with the area, I ask a nearby beach patrol officer for directions.)

TextContext.SourceString: 电影节的会场？是星庇所的小姑娘在附近搭的几个摊子吗？往那边走。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The film festival? Are you talking about the stalls the girl from Astral Sanctuary set up? Head that way.

TextContext.SourceString: 对了，这个电影节打算办几天？你们可别把位置占太久咯，一个星期之后，海滩要做烟火大会的观众席。
TextContext.LocalizedString: By the way, how long is the festival going to last? Don’t hog the space too long; a week from now it'll be used for the fireworks show.

TextContext.SourceString: （依照巡逻员指示的方向走过去，很快便看到了星绘和其他志愿者们忙碌的身影。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Following the officer’s directions, I soon spot Celestia and the volunteers bustling about.)

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈，在这边哦！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Over here, Navigator!

TextContext.SourceString: （之前利用一些关系，帮星绘找来了三台电影放映机，布置在三个小型露天放映场之中。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I previously called in some favors and managed to get three projectors for Celestia. They are set up in three small outdoor screening areas.)

TextContext.SourceString: （虽然是用旧的放映机，但技术上可以实现阳光下放映也看得清屏幕的效果。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Even though they’re quite old, they still function well enough to show clear images in daylight.)

TextContext.SourceString: 我还带来了一些喜欢的电影
TextContext.LocalizedString: I also brought along some of my favorite films.

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，之前有和大家提到，可以带一些自己喜爱的作品来电影节放映。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Nice. I told everyone they could bring their favorite movies for the festival.

TextContext.SourceString: 不知道前辈都喜欢什么样的影片？我很感兴趣~
TextContext.LocalizedString: What kind of movies do you like? I'm curious~

TextContext.SourceString: 这边的场地很大啊
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's quite a large venue.

TextContext.SourceString: 是呀。这里本来很难租到的，不过听说是星庇所举办的活动，就破例低价租给我们一天。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Haha, it sure is. This place is usually fully booked. But when they heard it was an Astral Sanctuary event, they made an exception and rented it to us at a discounted price for the day.

TextContext.SourceString: 电影也是很好的疗愈主题呢。如果不是前辈之前和我提到了电影的话题，我也不会想到这点。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Movies are great for healing. If you hadn’t brought it up, I wouldn’t have thought of this.

TextContext.SourceString: 虽然我也很喜欢电影，不过一直以来都只是一个人看。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I've always liked movies, but I usually watch them by myself.

TextContext.SourceString: （和星绘聊了一些关于放映活动和电影的话题。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Celestia and I chat about the event and movies.)

TextContext.SourceString: （回过神来，放映场附近已经聚集了很多人。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As I look around, I realize a lot of people have gathered at the venue.)

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈，我得先去引导大家入场了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I need to guide everyone to their seats.

TextContext.SourceString: 有两把放着电子烟花棒的椅子，那是给我和前辈预留的位子，等我哦——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Look for two chairs with electric sparklers. I reserved them for us. Be right back!

TextContext.SourceString: （星绘没来得及说完话就去忙碌了。于是找到了预留位置坐下。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Celestia rushes off before finishing her sentence. I find our reserved seats and sit down.)

TextContext.SourceString: （放映的几乎都是旧日地球的片子。悬疑片、科幻片、通心粉西部片……很快看的入迷了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The screenings mostly feature old Earth films: mystery, sci-fi, spaghetti Westerns... I quickly become engrossed.)

TextContext.SourceString: （回过神来，发现星绘悄悄地打了招呼，然后坐在身边。就这样和星绘并肩观影。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I snap back to reality as Celestia waves and takes her seat beside me. We watch side by side.)

TextContext.SourceString: ——“我们必须把魔戒送到西方极乐世界去！”
TextContext.LocalizedString: “We must take the One Ring to the Land of Bliss!”

TextContext.SourceString: （似乎是师徒九人将一枚魔力戒指送到西方的旅行故事。星绘看的津津有味。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It seems to be about a group journeying west to destroy a powerful ring. Celestia is captivated.)

TextContext.SourceString: ——“熄火了！我们的车子熄火了！”
TextContext.LocalizedString: “Stalled! The engine's stalled!”

TextContext.SourceString: （似乎是一辆军用悍马在战区城市熄火而引发的巷战故事。星绘看的提心吊胆。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The story seems to follow a military Humvee stalling in a war-torn city, igniting a street battle. Celestia is on edge.)

TextContext.SourceString: ——“那个女人接受了假面改造，从此不再是人类了！”
TextContext.LocalizedString: “She has undergone a mask transformation. She is no longer human!”

TextContext.SourceString: （似乎是恐怖英雄电影。星绘好几次几乎吓得从椅子上跳了起来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It appears to be a horror superhero movie. Celestia is startled several times, almost jumping from her seat.)

TextContext.SourceString: （愉快的观影时间结束了。观众们一边回味电影情节，一边慢慢离开会场。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As the screenings end, the audience slowly leaves the venue, reminiscing about the stories.)

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈，大家都心满意足的样子，电影果然是很有魅力的事物啊。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The audience seems satisfied, Navigator. Movies truly are enchanting.

TextContext.SourceString: 星绘今天也辛苦了
TextContext.LocalizedString: Thank you for your hard work, Celestia.

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，我的话还好。虽然白天很忙，不过看电影算是很好的休息方式啦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's no big deal. Although it was busy today, watching movies gave me some rest.

TextContext.SourceString: 其实还有几部电影没来得及播放，活动结束之后，放映机就要送回去了，所以……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Actually, we still have a couple of movies left. Once the event is over, the projectors have to be returned, so...

TextContext.SourceString: 好像还有一些电影没看完
TextContext.LocalizedString: I think we still have a few movies left.

TextContext.SourceString: 是呀，好不容易借来的设备，如果不看完的话，就太可惜了不是吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yeah. We've gone through the trouble of borrowing the equipment. It would be a shame not to finish them, don’t you think?

TextContext.SourceString: 我和前辈想到一起去了呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hehe, you read my mind.

TextContext.SourceString: 那个……不知道前辈有没有时间，和我一起看一看剩下的电影……？
TextContext.LocalizedString: So... Um... I was wondering if you'd be free to watch the remaining movies with me...

TextContext.SourceString: 那就把这些电影看完吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Of course, let's finish them up!

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯嗯！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yay!

TextContext.SourceString: （和开心的星绘一起回到座位上。这一次是只有两个人的露天电影放映场。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I return to my seat with an excited Celestia. This time, it’s just the two of us.)

TextContext.SourceString: （很快，时间临近午夜。只剩下最后一部电影了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Time flies. We're down to the last film near midnight.)

TextContext.SourceString: （电影的第一个镜头，是红到发紫的夕阳下，坦克如同钢铁洪流般前进。炮火声震碎了夜晚的寂静。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The opening scene shows columns of tanks advancing under a purple sunset, gunfire tearing through the quiet night.)

TextContext.SourceString: （——这是一部讲述世界大战的电影。星绘目不转睛，时刻关注着主人公们的命运……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It’s a movie about the Great War. Celestia intently follows the fate of the protagonists.)

TextContext.SourceString: （……几乎完全遗忘了时间，直到影片念出最后期盼和平的旁白而结束。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Time slips away until the final hopeful narration for peace concludes the film.)

TextContext.SourceString: （星绘似乎还没有从电影令人怀念的氛围中走出来，坐在椅子上，怔怔地眨着眼。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Still affected by the nostalgic atmosphere of the movie, Celestia sits there, blinking blankly.)

TextContext.SourceString: 星绘，电影已经放完了
TextContext.LocalizedString: The movie is over, Celestia.

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，放完了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yeah, it’s over...

TextContext.SourceString: ……前辈，最后那个愿望，没能实现啊……
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...The final wish, it never came true...

TextContext.SourceString: 愿望？
TextContext.LocalizedString: The wish?

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，那些从战争中活下来的人们的愿望。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Mm-hmm, the wish of the survivors.

TextContext.SourceString: 那时候的人们，期盼着未来是一个新的世界。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Back then, people yearned for a future that promised a new world.

TextContext.SourceString: 期盼着我们后来的人，能努力做的更好。
TextContext.LocalizedString: They hoped the generations that followed would strive to do better.

TextContext.SourceString: 可是从来没有实现过呢。就算是来到了这个“新的世界”，也没有实现……
TextContext.LocalizedString: It never happened... We reached this "new world," but it didn’t come true...

TextContext.SourceString: 这并不是你的问题
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's not your fault.

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，我知道的。但不是因为这部电影，而是……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I know that. It wasn’t just because of the movie, but...

TextContext.SourceString: 但这只是一场电影
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's just a movie.

TextContext.SourceString: 是呀，只是一场电影。所以，并不只是因为这个……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yes, it’s just a movie. But still...

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈，即使我的努力不会改变什么，即使和过去人们的期盼一样无法兑现，我也不会因此气馁的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Even if my efforts prove futile, and I can’t fulfill the hopes of those before us, I won’t be discouraged.

TextContext.SourceString: 但什么都推动不了的话，未来的人们还是会不停地面对同样的苦难吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: But if nothing changes, future generations will face the same sufferings, won’t they?

TextContext.SourceString: 如果是这样的话，就算来到了“新的世界”，获得了新的身体，可又有什么用呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: If that's the case, what good is a new body in a new world?

TextContext.SourceString: （……无法回答的沉重问题。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (...I am unable to answer such a complex question.)

TextContext.SourceString: （似乎也意识到了这一点，星绘露出难为情的表情。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Seemingly realizing this, Celestia appears a bit downhearted.)

TextContext.SourceString: （也许要就此沉默下去……就没有什么能够分散她的注意力的东西吗？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I have to break the silence... Is there anything I can do to divert her attention?)

TextContext.SourceString: ……说来，到底是什么东西一直硌着腰？
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...By the way, what's this thing poking me all this time?

TextContext.SourceString: 啊，是给前辈标记座位的电子烟花棒？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh, it’s the electronic sparkler reserved to mark your seat.

TextContext.SourceString: 本来是想用来增加观影氛围的。一直顾着看电影，忘记了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I wanted to use it to enhance the viewing atmosphere, but I was too focused on the movies and forgot...

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈想要点亮它吗？只要按动最下面的开关就好。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Would you like to light it up? Just flip the switch at the bottom.

TextContext.SourceString: 点亮烟花棒
TextContext.LocalizedString: Turn on the sparkler.

TextContext.SourceString: （根据星绘的提示，“点燃”了电子烟花棒。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As instructed by Celestia, I “light” the sparkler.)

TextContext.SourceString: （电子光束发出的白光，照亮了各自的面容，在彼此相对的目光中跃动着。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The sparkler's white light illuminates our faces as our eyes lock.)

TextContext.SourceString: 因为是模拟焰火的电子玩具，所以亮度和“燃放”时间都很短暂，也无法照的很远……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Since it's a toy that simulates fireworks, its brightness is low and its duration short...

TextContext.SourceString: 也许星庇所的存在就像它一样
TextContext.LocalizedString: Perhaps Astral Sanctuary is just like the sparkler.

TextContext.SourceString: ……只能绽放出这样小的光芒吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...That it may only emit such a faint glow?

TextContext.SourceString: 但微小的光芒也照亮了很多人的眼睛
TextContext.LocalizedString: But even a faint glow can illuminate many eyes.

TextContext.SourceString: 所以，一定有什么能被你改变的事物
TextContext.LocalizedString: Surely, there are things you can change.

TextContext.SourceString: ……前辈，是这样相信的吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Do you really believe that?

TextContext.SourceString: 坚定地点头。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Nod in affirmation.
...Yes.

TextContext.SourceString: 我……也相信前辈。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I... believe in you too.

TextContext.SourceString: 谢谢您，这个时候在我的身边。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Thank you for staying by my side.

TextContext.SourceString: （短暂的光芒，就在此时此刻熄灭了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The ephemeral light goes out.)

TextContext.SourceString: （但仍有月和星光，照耀着静悄悄的放映场，和最后两位观众的身影。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (But the moon and stars continue to shine on the quiet screening area and its final two audiences.)

TextContext.SourceString: （第一天去星庇所上班的路上，忽然被一个坐在广场水池边、垂头丧气的人缠上了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (On my first day commuting to Astral Sanctuary, I suddenly got caught up with someone sitting dejectedly by the plaza fountain.)

TextContext.SourceString: 不见了，怎么找都找不到……
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's gone. I can't find it anywhere...

TextContext.SourceString: 求你……帮帮我……找不到了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Please... Help me find it...

TextContext.SourceString: 那首歌……是谁来着……星星……？
TextContext.LocalizedString: That song... who sang it... stars...?

TextContext.SourceString: （对方失魂落魄的样子，看起来和崩溃症有关，于是紧急联络了星绘。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The distraught man seems to be exhibiting signs of Collapse Syndrome, so I contact Celestia immediately.)

TextContext.SourceString: 知道了，我马上就过去！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Got it. On my way!

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈，请您安抚住患者，千万不要让他乱跑乱动，拜托了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Please keep the patient calm and make sure he doesn’t wander off—I'm counting on you!

TextContext.SourceString: 紧急记录病情的话，就用星空板——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Remember to use your Star Pad to record his condition.

TextContext.SourceString: （按照星绘的说明，拿出之前从她那里得到的星空板。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Following Celestia's instructions, I take out the Star Pad she gave me.)

TextContext.SourceString: （星空板是一块平板电脑，也是崩溃症患者的电子病历，但因为第一天上班，完全不知道怎么使用病例软件。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The Star Pad is a tablet and an electronic record for Collapse Syndrome patients, but since it's my first day, I have no clue how to use the patient management app.)

TextContext.SourceString: 呜，好痛苦……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ah. It hurts...

TextContext.SourceString: 我、我不能在这！我要去找回来！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I-I can't stay here! I must find it!

TextContext.SourceString: 等下……！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wait...!

TextContext.SourceString: （挡住那个崩溃症患者的去路，结果不小心被他撞倒在地。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Trying to stop the patient from leaving, I accidentally get knocked down by him.)

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈？到底发生了什么事？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What on earth happened here?

TextContext.SourceString: （恍惚之中听到了星绘惊讶的声音。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (In a daze, I hear Celestia's surprised voice.)

TextContext.SourceString: 您为什么和那个人……就这么交叠在一起，躺在地面上……？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Why are you... tangled up with him on the ground...?

TextContext.SourceString: 我也觉得很突然……
TextContext.LocalizedString: It all happened so fast...

TextContext.SourceString: 是啊，我也稍微被这个场面给吓到了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Um, I'm a bit startled by this scene myself...

TextContext.SourceString: 在人生之路上，遭遇了小小波折而已
TextContext.LocalizedString: Just hit a little bump on the road of life.

TextContext.SourceString: 诶？不、不愧是前辈，这种情况下也能游刃有余地说出帅气的话……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Eh? W-Wow, even in this situation, you come up with something interesting...

TextContext.SourceString: ……总之，还是先从地上起来吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Anyway, let's get you up first.

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈，拉住我的手。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Here, take my hand.

TextContext.SourceString: （星绘的手心出了汗，大概是接到电话后就飞快地跑过来了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Celestia's palm is sweaty—she must've rushed over right after I called.)

TextContext.SourceString: （把倒在地上的患者也拉了起来，然后为星绘讲述前因后果。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I help the patient up before explaining the situation to Celestia.)

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，情况我了解了。患者的病情看起来有些严重，我需要进行紧急心理干预。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I see. The patient's condition seems quite severe. I need to perform an emergency intervention.

TextContext.SourceString: （因为还不熟悉疗愈的过程，所以先站在一旁，仔细观察星绘的一举一动。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Since I'm not familiar with the treatment procedure, I stand aside, carefully observing Celestia's every move.)

TextContext.SourceString: ——请别害怕，我是星庇所的星绘。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Please don't be afraid. My name is Celestia. I work at Astral Sanctuary.

TextContext.SourceString: ——嗯，我能帮上你的……是的，我是疗愈师……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Mm-hmm, I can help you... Yes, I'm a healer...

TextContext.SourceString: ——会好起来的，你不是还在和我交流吗？还来得及，你必须相信我……
TextContext.LocalizedString: You'll be fine. There's still time, you have to trust me...

TextContext.SourceString: （星绘的紧急心理干预生效了，患者逐渐安静了下来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Celestia's emergency intervention worked, and the patient has gradually calmed down.)

TextContext.SourceString: （不过，患者看上去还是有些彷徨，而星绘也在思索着什么。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (However, the patient still looks a bit lost, and Celestia seems to be considering her next step.)

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈，虽然这么问有点突然……嗯，您熟悉音乐或歌曲什么的吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I know this is a bit out of the blue, but are you familiar with a lot of songs?

TextContext.SourceString: 那位患者情绪虽然缓和了下来，但又一直呢喃着一首歌的名字……
TextContext.LocalizedString: The patient's calmed down a bit, but he keeps murmuring about the name of a song...

TextContext.SourceString: （星绘说出了歌名。听到歌名的同时，一旁的患者抬起头，目光中也充满了怀念感。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As Celestia tells me the name of the song, the patient lifts up his head, his eyes filled with longing.)

TextContext.SourceString: 那是一首怀念亲人的歌
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's a song about remembering loved ones.

TextContext.SourceString: 啊，前辈能知道的话，真是太好了。我对现在的流行音乐实在不太懂……
TextContext.LocalizedString: You know it? That's great! I don't really understand pop music nowadays...

TextContext.SourceString: 曲子的话倒是能哼出来
TextContext.LocalizedString: I can hum the tune, though.

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈也很喜欢音乐吗？这下又找到一个和前辈的共同点呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: So, you enjoy music too? That's another thing we have in common.

TextContext.SourceString: 诶，不对，现在不是说这个的时候。之所以问这个，其实是因为……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh, wait, now's not the time for that. The reason I asked is because...

TextContext.SourceString: 崩溃症的加深会让患者逐渐丧失意识稳定性，所以他们会无意识地言说一些词语或话语。
TextContext.LocalizedString: As Collapse Syndrome progresses, patients lose their grip on reality, often muttering words or phrases unconsciously.

TextContext.SourceString: 这些词语和话语对他们很重要，也是延缓崩溃症的关键。
TextContext.LocalizedString: These words hold great importance for them and are key to slowing the syndrome's advance.

TextContext.SourceString: 可是我不了解现在流行的音乐，一时不知道该怎么办……前辈，有什么好办法吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: But I don't really know much about current music trends, so I'm at a bit of a loss... Do you have any ideas?

TextContext.SourceString: 可以用星空板来播放给他听
TextContext.LocalizedString: We could play the song from my Star Pad.

TextContext.SourceString: 对呀，前辈真是提醒我了！星空板是具备平板电脑功能来着。
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's a great idea! I forgot the Star Pad functions like a tablet.

TextContext.SourceString: 好在我随身携带了星空板——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Luckily, I've got it with me...

TextContext.SourceString: （点击星空板之后，只有右边的屏幕亮了起来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After tapping the Star Pad, only the right side of the screen lit up.)

TextContext.SourceString: ……左半边的屏幕怎么了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...What happened to the left side of the screen?

TextContext.SourceString: 您说，可能是刚才碰撞的时候弄坏了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You think it might've been damaged when the patient knocked you over?

TextContext.SourceString: ……好吧，不能把患者放在这里不管，只好想办法把患者送回星庇所——
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...In any case, we can't just leave the patient here. We need to get him back to Astral Sanctuary...

TextContext.SourceString: 不，其实还有办法
TextContext.LocalizedString: No, there's another way.

TextContext.SourceString: 咦，前辈想到了什么办法？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh? What do you have in mind?

TextContext.SourceString: 星绘来唱，我来教你
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'll teach you, and you sing it to him.

TextContext.SourceString: 诶？前辈要我来唱？您的意思是，我来唱的效果对患者会更好？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Me? You want me to sing? You think my singing could actually help him?

TextContext.SourceString: 可前辈，我上学时音乐课的成绩可是排在全班第……
TextContext.LocalizedString: B-But, I never did well in music class back in school...

TextContext.SourceString: 算、算了，事出紧急，我不能有那么多顾虑。
TextContext.LocalizedString: N-Never mind, I shouldn't be worrying about this. A man's life is at stake.

TextContext.SourceString: 要是唱的不好听，前辈可千万别笑话我啊……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Just promise you won't laugh if it sounds terrible...

TextContext.SourceString: （用半损坏的星空板查了歌词，然后教星绘为患者唱了那首歌。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I used the half-broken Star Pad to look up the lyrics and guided Celestia as she sang to the patient.)

TextContext.SourceString: （歌声既不难听也不动听，普通人的水准。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Her singing is neither moving nor unpleasant. Average at best.)

TextContext.SourceString: 我来唱
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'll sing it to him.

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，那就拜托前辈了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Alright, I'm counting on you!

TextContext.SourceString: 诶，您说最好先捂起耳朵？不然会造成误伤？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Eh? You want me to cover my ears? To avoid collateral damage?

TextContext.SourceString: ……会有这种效果的话，您刚才为什么满满答应下来啊！
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...If your singing is this bad, why did you volunteer to sing?

TextContext.SourceString: 算、算了，事出紧急，我不能有那么多顾虑。
TextContext.LocalizedString: N-Never mind. This is an emergency. A man's life is at stake.

TextContext.SourceString: 总之，我会承担后果的，请前辈开始吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Anyway, I'll take responsibility for the potential consequences, so please, go ahead!

TextContext.SourceString: （还是为患者唱了那首歌。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I went ahead and sang the song to the patient.)

TextContext.SourceString: （歌声既不动听也不难听，普通人的水准。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The singing is neither moving nor unpleasant. Average at best.)

TextContext.SourceString: ……啊。你、你找到了？你帮我找到了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Ah. You—you found it? You really found it for me...

TextContext.SourceString: 你是第一个对我这么好的人……
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're the first person to be so kind to me...

TextContext.SourceString: 如果不是前辈遇到了你，也许情况会变得更糟糕。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Had you not been here, Navigator, the situation could have been a lot worse.

TextContext.SourceString: 还是要多谢前辈才行哦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We really have to thank you for this.

TextContext.SourceString: 是啊……多、多谢你，多谢你们……帮我找到了……我的星星……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yes... Th-thank you, thank you both... for finding...my star...

TextContext.SourceString: （和星绘一起接受了对方的致谢。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (We both accepted his gratitude together.)

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈，他的意识状况终于稳定下来了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: His mental state has finally stabilized.

TextContext.SourceString: 原来，曾经有一位亲人和他相依为命。可那位亲人先于他患上崩溃症，最后下落不明……
TextContext.LocalizedString: It turns out he once had a loved one who stayed by his side. But that person contracted Collapse Syndrome before he did and eventually went missing...

TextContext.SourceString: 后来，崩溃症也开始影响他的意识，他开始遗忘了和那位亲人有关的一切。
TextContext.LocalizedString: As Collapse Syndrome started affecting him, he began to forget everything related to that loved one.

TextContext.SourceString: 只有哼唱这首歌，他才能稍稍记起亲人的面庞……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Only by humming this song could he slightly remember her face...

TextContext.SourceString: 可是现在他连那首歌也忘记了，只剩下名字……
TextContext.LocalizedString: But now, even the melody have slipped away from him, leaving just the song's name...

TextContext.SourceString: 幸好能有前辈即时介入。接下来只要我们带他回到星庇所，进一步帮助他缓解病情。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Fortunately, you were able to intervene in time. Now, we just need to take him back to Astral Sanctuary to further alleviate his condition.

TextContext.SourceString: 话说，星空板还能修好吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: By the way, can the Star Pad be repaired?

TextContext.SourceString: 噗……前辈好紧张，没有打算责怪前辈啦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Heh... Don't worry. I wasn't going to blame you.

TextContext.SourceString: 这块板子其实是我在欧泊时使用的，已经很旧了，就算没有发生今天的事，也用不了太久了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I got this Star Pad back at P.U.S. It's quite old, and even if it weren't damaged today, it wouldn't have lasted much longer.

TextContext.SourceString: 星空板修理费就从工资里扣除吧……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Please deduct the repair cost from my salary...

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，没必要修理了。毕竟是我在欧泊时用的旧物。
TextContext.LocalizedString: There's no need to repair it. It's an ancient item from my time at P.U.S anyway.

TextContext.SourceString: 光是更换屏幕就要一大笔钱钱，总之是不太划算的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's going to cost a fortune just to fix the screen; it's not worth it.

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈就用我的那块星空板好了。虽然也是旧物就是了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you don't mind, you can use mine instead. It's old too, but it still works...

TextContext.SourceString: 话说回来，今天是前辈第一天上班呢，就遇到这样的突发事件。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Anyway, I can't believe you've already encountered such a crisis on your first day.

TextContext.SourceString: 但前辈的表现非常棒，怎么样的夸赞都不算夸张呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You handled it brilliantly. I can't praise you enough.

TextContext.SourceString: 和前辈一起工作，一定能让我学到更多吧？还请多多指教了，前辈！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Surely, I'll learn a lot from you as we work together. I'm looking forward to that, Navigator!

TextContext.SourceString: （作为第一次和星绘进行疗愈工作的纪念品，收下了半损坏的星空板。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I took the half-broken Star Pad as a memento of my first day at work with Celestia.)

TextContext.SourceString: （来星庇所上班，在门口听到有“人”喊星绘的名字。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Upon arriving at Astral Sanctuary for work, I hear someone—no, something—calling for Celestia at the entrance.)

TextContext.SourceString: 有你的快递——星绘——
TextContext.LocalizedString: There's a package for you, Celestia!

TextContext.SourceString: 我可以帮忙代收
TextContext.LocalizedString: I can receive it on her behalf.

TextContext.SourceString: （确认外包装没有破损后，从快递机器人那里接收了快递。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After confirming that the packaging is intact, I accept the package from the delivery robot.)

TextContext.SourceString: 邮件附带了一封语音邮件，请收件人一并查收——哔哔——
TextContext.LocalizedString: The mail comes attached with a voice message, please check—beep beep—

TextContext.SourceString: （又从快递机器人那里接收了留言。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I accept the voice message from the delivery robot.)

TextContext.SourceString: “嗨！星绘，你在欧泊时租用的储存柜要到期了，我就把你的一些旧物邮寄到星庇所，希望能用来解压！虽然我不知道该怎么用啦……”
TextContext.LocalizedString: “Hey, Celestia! The rental on your storage locker in P.U.S is about to expire. I'm sending some of your old stuff to Astral Sanctuary. I hope they can help you relax! Although I have no idea how to use any of them...”

TextContext.SourceString: “就算工作有再忙，也要好好调整身心才行，我可是会很担心的！”
TextContext.LocalizedString: "Even if work gets hectic, make sure to take care of yourself—I worry about you!"

TextContext.SourceString: “等我闲下来之后就去看你！回见哟~”
TextContext.LocalizedString: "I'll visit you once I'm free! See you soon~"

TextContext.SourceString: 验收完毕的话，我可就离开了哦——哔哔——
TextContext.LocalizedString: If everything's in order, I'll be on my way—beep beep—

TextContext.SourceString: （目送机器人离开后，捧着快递箱走进星庇所。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After seeing the bot off, I carry the package into Astral Sanctuary.)

TextContext.SourceString: 姆呼……姆……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Zzz... Zzz...

TextContext.SourceString: （正在小睡补觉的星绘，总觉得看上去比平时更加疲惫。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Celestia is taking a nap, looking more exhausted than usual.)

TextContext.SourceString: 您好，有人吗？请问有在营业吗……？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hello, is anyone here? Are you open...

TextContext.SourceString: （不忍叫醒星绘。把快递箱放到柜子上后，暂代星绘接待来访的患者。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Not wanting to wake Celestia, I place the package on the cabinet before standing in for her.)

TextContext.SourceString: 呼……诶，怎、怎么睡到这个时候了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Phew... Eh? What time is it...

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈，你是在……咦？是在帮我接待患者？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You’re... Oh, you’re helping with the patients?

TextContext.SourceString: 好歹也是星庇所的一员了嘛
TextContext.LocalizedString: Well, I work here, don't I?

TextContext.SourceString: 我知道，可是毕竟您还在熟悉流程中，就让您这么忙碌……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I know, but you're still getting your bearings. You're busy enough already...

TextContext.SourceString: 接下来就交给我吧。前辈可以把所有来访患者的登记名——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Leave it to me. Could you please write down the names of all the outpatients...?

TextContext.SourceString: （星绘扶着额头，忽然晃了晃，身子一歪，几乎栽倒下去。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Holding her forehead, Celestia suddenly sways, her body tilting, nearly falling down.)

TextContext.SourceString: （幸好发生在眼前，于是立刻拉住了星绘的手。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Fortunately, standing right in front of her, I catch her in time.)

TextContext.SourceString: 谢、谢谢前辈……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Th-Thank you...

TextContext.SourceString: 刚才一转身忽然头好晕……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I suddenly felt dizzy when I turned around just now...

TextContext.SourceString: 您说，是连续睡眠不足导致的机能紊乱？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you saying it’s a temporary dysfunction caused by lack of sleep?

TextContext.SourceString: 是啊，这几天睡眠时间的确很不稳定。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Now that I think about it, my sleep has been rather erratic over the past few days.

TextContext.SourceString: 让星绘坐下缓一缓
TextContext.LocalizedString: Celestia, take a seat.

TextContext.SourceString: 啊、好，好的……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ah, o-okay...

TextContext.SourceString: 给星绘倒一杯温水
TextContext.LocalizedString: Here, have a warm cup of water.
...Thank you.

TextContext.SourceString: 现在勉强去自己工作，只会给前辈帮倒忙。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Forcing myself to work now would just get in your way.

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈，那就拜托您了，我稍微清醒一下。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'll leave it to you for a bit while I clear my head.

TextContext.SourceString: （让星绘安心之后，继续接待访客。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After calming Celestia down, I continue to receive visitors.)

TextContext.SourceString: （送走最后一批访客。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I see off the last visitors.)

TextContext.SourceString: （看到星绘似乎恢复了精神，开始了自己的工作，稍微感到了安心。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Seeing Celestia recover her strength, I start my own work, feeling relieved.)

TextContext.SourceString: （忽然看到邮寄给星绘的快递箱似乎被人打开过了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Suddenly, I notice that the package addressed to Celestia has been opened.)

TextContext.SourceString: 赶快检查快递箱的情况
TextContext.LocalizedString: Inspect the package.

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈？怎么了，一脸紧张的样子？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is something wrong? You look worried.

TextContext.SourceString: 您说帮我代收了快递，因为太忙忘记照看，好像被人打开过了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You received a package for me and were too busy to keep an eye on it, and someone had opened it?

TextContext.SourceString: 唔，我倒是不记得最近有买过什么……嗯？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hmm, I don't recall ordering anything recently... What's this?

TextContext.SourceString: 您看，箱子旁边有一封全息留言。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Look, there's a holographic message next to the package.

TextContext.SourceString: “非常抱歉，不小心搞错了箱子，误拆了您的快递，保证什么都没有拿走……”
TextContext.LocalizedString: “Sorry! I got the boxes mixed up and accidentally opened yours. I promise that I didn't take anything...”

TextContext.SourceString: 原来是搞错了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: So it was just a mix-up...

TextContext.SourceString: 是呀，只是一场乌龙而已。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yep, just a simple mistake.

TextContext.SourceString: 松了一口气……
TextContext.LocalizedString: What a relief...

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈这下可以放心了吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You can relax now, Navigator.

TextContext.SourceString: 说起来，您手里拿着的这枚望远镜是……？
TextContext.LocalizedString: By the way, is that a telescope you’re holding...?

TextContext.SourceString: 您说是刚刚检查快递箱时顺手拿出来，就一直握在手里来着？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You took it out while inspecting the package and have been holding on to it since?

TextContext.SourceString: 这么说，前辈好像知道这个快递箱？能告诉我是怎么回事吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: It sounds like you know about the package? Could you tell me what's going on?

TextContext.SourceString: （于是把白天帮星绘代收快递的事说了一遍。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I recount the event of receiving the package on Celestia's behalf ealier today.)

TextContext.SourceString: 原来是这样啊。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ah, I see.

TextContext.SourceString: 寄邮件给我的，是我还在欧泊时认识的一个好朋友。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The sender is an old friend of mine from my days in P.U.S.

TextContext.SourceString: 这枚望远镜，还有箱子里的东西，当然也是那时候留下的……
TextContext.LocalizedString: This telescope, along with everything in the box, were things I left behind back then...

TextContext.SourceString: 好像还没有和前辈说起过我的事呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Speaking of which, I haven't told you about my past.

TextContext.SourceString: （望远镜被星绘从手中轻轻地取走。随后她熟练地调试起来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Celestia gently takes the telescope from my hand and starts adjusting it.)

TextContext.SourceString: ——这个时间的话，已经看不到月亮了，不过星星的话——
TextContext.LocalizedString: The Moon isn't visible at this time. But we should still be able to see the stars...

TextContext.SourceString: 这个镜筒是我的母亲给我的礼物。
TextContext.LocalizedString: This telescope was a gift from my mother.

TextContext.SourceString: 每当我学到新的知识，做到别的孩子没做到的事……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Every time I learned something new or did something other kids couldn't...

TextContext.SourceString: 母亲就会买下各种各样、别人买不到的东西，然后公开地奖励我。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Mother would purchase all sorts of unique things that no one else could get and reward me publicly.

TextContext.SourceString: 我第一次观测天体，独立测绘了南十字星座，她就为我订制了这枚十字星挂坠。
TextContext.LocalizedString: After I independently mapped the Southern Cross the first time I observed celestial bodies, she had this cross pendant made for me.

TextContext.SourceString: 因为她希望我成为一颗比任何人都闪耀的星星。
TextContext.LocalizedString: She had hoped that I would become a star more dazzling than anyone else.

TextContext.SourceString: ……我没有那种天赋和能力，成为一颗闪耀着的星星，这一点我还是很有自觉的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...I don't have the talent or ability to become that shining star. I knew that, even back then.

TextContext.SourceString: 但母亲她，完全不在意这些，只是一心希望我能继承她在欧泊的职务和地位。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But mother didn't care about any of that. All she hoped was for me to take over her position and status at P.U.S.

TextContext.SourceString: 所以，后来……
TextContext.LocalizedString: When I grew up...

TextContext.SourceString: 后来你离开了欧泊吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You left P.U.S, didn't you?

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯。当我提出，要开辟属于自己的道路后，母亲默许我离开了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Mm-hmm. When I asked to forge my own path, my mother allowed me to leave, though she never really acknowledged my dreams.

TextContext.SourceString: 尽管她从来没有肯定过我的想法。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Even though she never really acknowledged my dreams.

TextContext.SourceString: 你会找到自己的答案
TextContext.LocalizedString: You'll find your own answers.

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，是呀。现在的我，其实已经找到了一个答案。
TextContext.LocalizedString: In fact, I already have.

TextContext.SourceString: ——无论月亮、星星，亦或是太阳，无论是什么天体，都是这片浩瀚宇宙的一部分。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Be it the moon, stars, or sun, all celestial bodies are part of this vast universe.

TextContext.SourceString: 在无边无际的黑暗中，散发着独属于自己的光芒。
TextContext.LocalizedString: In the endless darkness, each one of them emits its unique light.

TextContext.SourceString: 她的认可并不重要
TextContext.LocalizedString: Her approval does not define you.

TextContext.SourceString: 是呀。为什么一定要强求这份理解呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Exactly. Why must I insist on seeking her understanding?

TextContext.SourceString: 得不到的话，就裹足不前，祈求着终有一天能想明白吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: If she doesn't grant it, should I keep second-guessing myself, hoping to make sense of it all?

TextContext.SourceString: 如果看不透这些的话，我就不会坐在这里，和前辈您一起……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Had I not come to this realization, I wouldn’t be sitting here next to you...

TextContext.SourceString: 一想到有前辈这样，能够理解我的想法的人，现在就站在我的身边……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Knowing there's someone like you who understands me, right by my side...

TextContext.SourceString: 就像月亮一样，静悄悄地陪伴着看不清夜路的我。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It’s like the moon, quietly guiding me through the dark.

TextContext.SourceString: 只要这样想，干劲就会重新回到我的身上。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The more I think about it, the more motivated I am.

TextContext.SourceString: 所以，前辈，还希望您能多陪……更多指导还不够成熟的我。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you don't mind, Navigator... I hope you'll stay by my side and keep guiding me.

TextContext.SourceString: 没有问题。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Of course.

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯嗯……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Mm-hmm...

TextContext.SourceString: 接下来就……放下手边的工作，好好休息一会儿吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Now then... let's put our work aside for a bit and take a good rest.

TextContext.SourceString: 我来教前辈观测天体吧，好吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: How about I teach you how to stargaze?

TextContext.SourceString: （看着调试望远镜的星绘变得逐渐开心起来，这下终于能放下心了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Seeing Celestia’s joy as she adjusts the telescope puts my mind at ease.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在小小的星庇所重新忙碌起来之前，小小地享受着平静的时光。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Before the little Sanctuary gets busy again, we quietly enjoy a moment of peace.)

TextContext.SourceString: （和星绘一起整理新一批崩溃症患者的档案。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Celestia and I are organizing the medical records of the latest Collapse Syndrome patients.)

TextContext.SourceString: 根据近期收集的访客自述来看，普遍存在的孤独情绪，是驱使大家来到星庇所接受治疗的首要原因。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Based on the recent visitor accounts, a common feeling of loneliness is the main drive for them to seek treatment at Astral Sanctuary.

TextContext.SourceString: 是崩溃症初期的表现
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's an early sign of Collapse Syndrome.

TextContext.SourceString: 您说的没错。如果是初期的话，还不会影响到深层意识，对行为也影响也有限。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Exactly. In the early stages, deep consciousness isn't affected, and the impact on behavior is minimal.

TextContext.SourceString: 但情绪上的表现，实际上只是内部变化的外部表达……
TextContext.LocalizedString: But emotional manifestations are, in fact, the external expressions of internal changes...

TextContext.SourceString: 如果不积极介入，就会陷入恶性循环
TextContext.LocalizedString: Without active intervention, the patients will fall into a vicious cycle.

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，“意识修复疗法”做不到根除崩溃症，也仅仅是延缓病程。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Mm-hmm. "Consciousness Repair Therapy" can't cure Collapse Syndrome but can only slow its progression.

TextContext.SourceString: 只有及时介入，我们的疗法才能为患者提供最大的效力。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Only with timely intervention can our treatment offer the greatest benefits to the patients.

TextContext.SourceString: 目前来星庇所进行咨询的人数不断升高，感觉前辈和我都有点周转不过来了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: With the number of patients coming here for consultations continuously on the rise, I feel like you and I are both overwhelmed.

TextContext.SourceString: 所以我想以星庇所的名义，举办一场公开的义诊，集中宣传“意识修复疗法”。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'd like to host a public outreach event in Astral Sanctuary's name to promote "Consciousness Repair Therapy."

TextContext.SourceString: 不过，这次活动的主题该怎么定调呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: But what should the theme of this event be?

TextContext.SourceString: 强调星庇所和大家的联系感怎么样？
TextContext.LocalizedString: How about emphasizing our connection with the community?

TextContext.SourceString: 以星庇所为中心，建立一个联系紧密的共同体吗？前辈的想法总是很成熟呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Creating a close-knit community centered on the Sanctuary? That's a mature perspective.

TextContext.SourceString: 以引航者的身份建立信任
TextContext.LocalizedString: Establish trust as a Navigator.

TextContext.SourceString: 是呀，前辈作为引航者，本身就是信赖关系的保障。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Good idea. Your role as the Navigator naturally fosters trust.

TextContext.SourceString: 在前辈来星庇所之前，这方面的工作，我做的一直很艰难……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Before you joined the Sanctuary, building that trust was something I struggled with...

TextContext.SourceString: 接下来的话，重要的议题就只剩下准备什么样的“信物”了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Now, we just need to decide on an item to symbolize this connection.

TextContext.SourceString: 如果能准备一份有意义的物品，强调出活动主题的话，这份“信物”也会成为“记忆的锚点”，帮助大家稳定意识状态。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If we can offer something meaningful to highlight the theme, it could act as a "Memory Anchor," helping stabilize people’s consciousness.

TextContext.SourceString: 只是能送些什么，我一时没有主意……
TextContext.LocalizedString: But I’m not sure what we should give...

TextContext.SourceString: 您说，可以是我最近比较关注的东西？确实是有啦……星芒咖啡ver.31.6.21.6？前辈觉得这个怎么样？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You think it should be something I've been interested in lately? Well, there is something... Starlight Coffee V31.6.21.6. What do you think?

TextContext.SourceString: （……预感到任由情况发展的话，最后只会送出奇怪的东西。得用其他物品吸引下她的注意力。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (...If I let her imagination run wild, we would end up giving away strange items. I need to redirect her focus.)

TextContext.SourceString: （也许快递箱里的旧物能带来灵感？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Perhaps something from the package could help?)

TextContext.SourceString: （因为并不清楚什么东西能派上用场，索性随机挑选了一样东西。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Not knowing what could be useful, I pick a random item.)

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈，您拿的是……诶，这串手链……？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What did you pick up...? Oh, this bracelet...?

TextContext.SourceString: 这是我在很小的时候，和妈妈一起做的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I made this with my mother when I was little.

TextContext.SourceString: 您看，这颗晶石后面还刻着我的名字……和妈妈的名字。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Look, this crystal has my name... and my mother's name engraved on it.

TextContext.SourceString: （星绘翻出其中一颗晶石，内侧以幼稚的字体刻着“星绘”的拼写。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Celestia shows me one of the bracelet's crystals, its backside engraved with her name in a child's handwriting.)

TextContext.SourceString: （似乎谈到小时候，星绘就会感到害羞，不过很快就能恢复成平时文静的表情。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Every time Celestia talks about her childhood, she seems shy for a moment before returning to her usual calmness.)

TextContext.SourceString: 还记得妈妈和我说，尘世间一切秩序不过是对头顶宇宙的模仿。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Mom once told me that all order of this mortal world is but an imitation of the cosmos above.

TextContext.SourceString: 行星永远围绕恒星旋转，从来不必担心迷失路途，这就是“天体的秩序”。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Planets orbit stars, never worried about losing their path—that's the "Celestial Order."

TextContext.SourceString: ……只是，现在的我，已经再不会像个孩子那样对她言听计从了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...But now, I no longer follow her blindly like a child.

TextContext.SourceString: 话说，前辈您拿出这个，究竟是想要……？
TextContext.LocalizedString: So, what are you trying to achieve by showing me this?

TextContext.SourceString: 想要帮上星绘的忙
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm trying to help you.

TextContext.SourceString: 原来是这样……前辈的直觉总是很准的样子，这一点比我强很多。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I see... Your intuition is usually right, far better than mine.

TextContext.SourceString: 像《机器狸猫》一样用神奇宝物来解决问题
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm trying to solve the problem with magic items, just like "Robo Cat."

TextContext.SourceString: 您说的是……？一部小时候看过的，主人公的机器狸猫用神奇宝物帮主人公解决问题的空想科学漫画？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh, are you talking about the sci-fi cartoon where the protagonist's robot cat uses magical items to solve problems?

TextContext.SourceString: 噗……我懂了，前辈总能给我出乎意料的回答……哈哈……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Haha...You're full of surprises...

TextContext.SourceString: 诶？您说要不要戴上试试看？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Huh? You think I should try it on?

TextContext.SourceString: 也许心情更接近小时候的话，会有一些不一样的感觉？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wearing something from my childhood might bring back different feelings?

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯。既然前辈这么说的话，那就……试试看？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Alright. I guess it doesn't hurt to try...

TextContext.SourceString: 为星绘戴上手链
TextContext.LocalizedString: Put the bracelet on Celestia.

TextContext.SourceString: （将手链轻轻系在星绘在手腕上，将松紧度调整舒适。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Gently fitting the bracelet on Celestia’s wrist, I adjust it to ensure it's comfortable.)

TextContext.SourceString: （星绘凝视着手链。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Celestia gazes at the bracelet.)

TextContext.SourceString: “天体的秩序”……吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: The "Celestial Order"...

TextContext.SourceString: 秩序的话，并不应该是那种从天而降的东西吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Order isn't something that just falls from the sky, right?

TextContext.SourceString: （似乎想到了什么，星绘的表情变得开朗了一些。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (She seems to have realized something, and her expression brightens up a bit.)

TextContext.SourceString: 您问我想到了什么？嗯……前辈的话，擅不擅长制作手工品？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What am I thinking of? Hmm... Are you any good at making crafts?

TextContext.SourceString: （接下来，聆听了星绘的想法。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I listen to her ideas.)

TextContext.SourceString: （几天后——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A few days later...)

TextContext.SourceString: （今天和星绘一起，以星庇所的名义举办公开义诊活动。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Today, alongside Celestia, we're hosting a public outreach event, endorsed by Astral Sanctuary.)

TextContext.SourceString: （来到现场的患者有着不同的身份、年龄和社会地位。星绘熟练地和来访的患者打着招呼。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Patients from diverse backgrounds, ages, and statuses are here. Celestia greets each of them proficiently.)

TextContext.SourceString: ——您好，吉马太太和伊丝缇娜太太，两位每次都是相伴而来呀。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hello, Mrs. Gima and Mrs. Estina. You two are inseparable, as always.

TextContext.SourceString: ——啊，路纳先生，您的状态比上次好多了。也烦请您代我向妹妹桑妮问好。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh, Mr. Luna! You're looking much better today. Please send my regards to Sunny.

TextContext.SourceString: ——安娜·帕夫洛夫娜女士，您的情况好些了吗？关于您和您孩子的情况……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Mrs. Anna Pavlovna, how are you feeling today? About you and your children...

TextContext.SourceString: 星绘记得住每个人的名字？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Do you know everyone by name?

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，“可以记住大家的名字”这件事，是我一直坚持的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yep. I have always insisted on remembering everyone by their name.

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈，到场人数应该足够了，我们开始吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I think we've got enough people here, Navigator. Shall we?

TextContext.SourceString: （和星绘一起搬出这些天制作的手链纪念品，发给在场的患者们。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Celestia and I take out the bracelets we've made over the past few days and hand them out to the visitors.)

TextContext.SourceString: 星绘小姐，这个手链是？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What's the bracelet for, Miss Celestia?

TextContext.SourceString: 是送给各位的义诊活动的“信物”哦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's a token for attending today's event.

TextContext.SourceString: 手链？还真是女孩子气的赠品哩，送我妹妹倒是正合适。
TextContext.LocalizedString: A bracelet? That's an elegant gift, perfect for my sister.

TextContext.SourceString: 您和桑妮的名字都篆刻在晶石串其中一颗的内侧了，也希望她能喜欢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Both your name and Sunny's are engraved on one of the crystals. I hope she’ll like it.

TextContext.SourceString: 咦？我看看……真的啊。其他人的，也都有自己的名字吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Really? Let me see... Oh, it’s true. Does everyone’s bracelet have their name on it?

TextContext.SourceString: 每个人都有的。而且我和前辈的手链上面，已经刻下了我们大家每个人的名字哦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yes, they do. And all your names are also engraved on both mine and the Navigator’s bracelets.

TextContext.SourceString: 因为想让大家了解到，自己并不是孤单一人。在星庇所，每个人都能像这些晶石一样，维系在一起……
TextContext.LocalizedString: We want everyone to understand that they are not alone. At Astral Sanctuary, we are all connected just like these crystals...

TextContext.SourceString: （与平时文静的少女不同，面对访客，丝毫没有怯场的星绘，正在努力向大家传达自己的想法。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (In contrast to her usual quiet demeanor, Celestia confidently expresses her thoughts to the visitors.)

TextContext.SourceString: 在这座城市中，大家或许彼此并不相识，有时候会觉得自己就像一颗原子，一粒星尘……
TextContext.LocalizedString: We may not know one another in this city. You might feel like just an atom, a speck of stardust...

TextContext.SourceString: 可其实，如果没有大家的存在，这座城市、这个世界也都无法构建起来的吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: But without each of you, the city, the world—none of it could exist.

TextContext.SourceString: 就像天体的秩序——并不是先天存在的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Just like celestial order—it wasn’t always there.

TextContext.SourceString: 不同的星体诞生，随后彼此影响，才形成了我们头顶这片可见的宇宙……
TextContext.LocalizedString: As different celestial bodies are born, they influence one another, forming the universe as we know it...

TextContext.SourceString: 我和前辈亲手制作的这份小小的纪念品，就是寄托着这样的想法，也希望它能够在各位的意识之海中“锚定”一个位置……
TextContext.LocalizedString: These bracelets we crafted hold this sentiment. We hope they can serve as an "anchor" in your sea of consciousness...

TextContext.SourceString: （星绘发自真心的，具备真情实感的话语，虽然声量不大，却真切地传达到了在场人们的心中。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Her heartfelt words, though softly spoken, resonate genuinely with everyone present.)

TextContext.SourceString: 对了，还没有和大家介绍——“引航者”，是我的前辈，也已经进驻星庇所，未来也会帮助大家，指引大家的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Now, it is my honor to introduce the Navigator, who has joined Astral Sanctuary and will be assisting everyone in the future.

TextContext.SourceString: （小声）前辈，要不要和大家打个招呼？
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Whispering) Navigator, would you like to say a few words?

TextContext.SourceString: 潇洒地亮相
TextContext.LocalizedString: Make a charismatic entrance

TextContext.SourceString: 噗哈哈……前辈这时候真的很帅气。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ha-ha... You look great.

TextContext.SourceString: 一定给大家留下了深刻的印象吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You must have left quite the lasting impression.

TextContext.SourceString: 沉稳地打招呼
TextContext.LocalizedString: Greet composedly

TextContext.SourceString: 这样沉稳的感觉，不愧是前辈。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Composed as ever. Well done, Navigator.

TextContext.SourceString: 一定给大家留下了干练的印象吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I’m certain you’ve left a professional impression.

TextContext.SourceString: （顺利地和在场所有访客进行了交流。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I interact with all the visitors.)

TextContext.SourceString: （义诊活动好评如潮，于是和星绘一起向大家承诺，今后会举办更多类似的活动。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The event is a great success. Celestia and I promise the visitors that we will hold more similar events in the future.)

TextContext.SourceString: 哟，这不是星绘小姐和引航者嘛，一起来采购吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Well, if it isn't Celestia and the Navigator! Are you two out shopping together?

TextContext.SourceString: 您好，我们想买一些新鲜食材。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hello there. We're looking to buy some fresh ingredients.

TextContext.SourceString: 食材啊……刚好新进了一批，你随便挑吧，送你了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ingredients, huh? It just so happens I have a fresh batch. Feel free to pick what you like—it's on the house.

TextContext.SourceString: 送我？为什么？
TextContext.LocalizedString: For free? Why?

TextContext.SourceString: 因为星绘姐姐平时对我们很好呀~上次我生病，还是你照顾我的呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Because you're always so nice to us! Remember when you took care of me when I was sick?

TextContext.SourceString: 小娜娜~身体好些了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Awww~ Nana are you feeling much better now?

TextContext.SourceString: 完全好了，我现在很健康！这些食材就当是我爸爸对星绘姐姐的感谢，请收下吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I've fully recovered, and super healthy now! Consider these ingredients a thank-you gift from my dad. Please, take them!

TextContext.SourceString: 这……真的不用了，你们看。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh, there's really no need. Look at all this...

TextContext.SourceString: （星绘举起手上拎着的袋子，透过包装，依稀能看到里面装着面包、小蛋糕、曲奇饼，还有一束斜插的鲜花。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: [Celestia lifts a bag filled with bread, cakes, cookies, and a bouquet of flowers peeking out.]

TextContext.SourceString: 不知道为什么，今天遇到的大家都特别……慷慨？一路走过来，收到了许多礼物，购物袋都装满了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I don't know why, but everyone I met today has been... too generous? I've received so many gifts that my bags are overflowing.

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈，你有什么头绪吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Any ideas, Navigator?

TextContext.SourceString: 那个……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hmm...

TextContext.SourceString: 这个……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Perhaps...

TextContext.SourceString: （接收到我求助的眼神，商铺老板连忙接上话茬。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Catching my subtle plea for help, the Shop Owner quickly jumped into the conversation.)

TextContext.SourceString: 是因为星绘小姐平时特别关照我们！
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's because Celestia always looks out for us!

TextContext.SourceString: 而且今天是——
TextContext.LocalizedString: And today is—

TextContext.SourceString: 咳咳！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ahem!

TextContext.SourceString: 今天是个好日子！对，好日子，星绘姐姐你就收下吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Today is a special day! You should enjoy it!

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯嗯，你就收下吧，这是娜娜的心意。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yeah, you should accept it. It's Nana's wish.

TextContext.SourceString: 好吧，那就听前辈的。看来今天确实是个好日子。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Alright, Navigator. Today is indeed a good day.

TextContext.SourceString: 而且，只要大家都健康平安，每一天都是好日子呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Every day is a good day as long as everyone is happy and healthy.

TextParam.SourceString: 采购完成后，和星绘一起回到宿舍。
TextParam.LocalizedString: Once the shopping's done, head back to the dorm with Celestia.

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈，我还是觉得今天发生的一切有点奇怪，你有什么头绪吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I can't help but feel everything that happened today was rather strange. Do you have any ideas?

TextContext.SourceString: （我顶着星绘灼灼的眼神，硬着头皮分析起来。还好大家都很配合，让我的努力没有白费……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I met Celestia's intense gaze and awkwardly began my analysis. Thankfully, everyone cooperated, so my efforts weren’t in vain...)

TextContext.SourceString: 所以，你这边的结论是，因为我深受大家喜爱，大家觉得我采购物资很辛苦，所以给我送了一堆礼物？
TextContext.LocalizedString: So, your conclusion is that everyone loves me so much, they went out of their way to gift me loads of presents because they thought my shopping was tiring?

TextContext.SourceString: 对，真相就是这样！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yup, that's exactly it!

TextContext.SourceString: 星绘觉得呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What do you think, Celestia?

TextContext.SourceString: 我觉得啊……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I think...

TextContext.SourceString: 一家一家打招呼为我准备惊喜，还要叮嘱他们别说漏嘴，前辈昨天应该忙了很久吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You worked very hard to surprise me. It must have taken you an entire day!

TextContext.SourceString: 难怪你明明正常时间下班，却深夜才回我的消息……
TextContext.LocalizedString: No wonder you clocked out at the usual time but only replied to my message late at night...

TextContext.SourceString: 谢谢你，前辈，这是我过过最好的生日，而且，永生难忘。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Thank you, Navigator. This has been the best birthday I've ever had. I'll never forget it.

TextContext.SourceString: 星绘……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Celestia...

TextContext.SourceString: 你怎么全都知道了！？
TextContext.LocalizedString: How did you figure it all out!?

TextContext.SourceString: 因为真的太反常了呀。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It was just too unusual...

TextContext.SourceString: 而且想来想去，会为我做这种事的，只有前辈了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Only you would do something like this for me.

TextContext.SourceString: 很巧，今年的生日，本来就只想和前辈一起度过……
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's funny cos I planned to spend my birthday with you anyway...

TextContext.SourceString: 等会儿，我就用前辈准备的惊喜，来亲手做一顿大餐吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I know! I'll make us dinner with the stuff you prepared!

TextContext.SourceString: 没问题~不过生日嘛，怎么少得了这个~
TextContext.LocalizedString: No problem~ But what's a birthday without this~

TextContext.SourceString: 好耶！不过大餐之前，还有个小惊喜~
TextContext.LocalizedString: Perfect! But there's a little surprise before that~

TextContext.SourceString: 欸，前辈！怎么突然蒙住我的眼睛——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Eh! Why did you cover my eyes...

TextContext.SourceString: 那作为餐前表演，星绘能大声朗读贺卡上的内容吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: As a pre-dinner show, could Celestia read aloud what's on the card?

TextContext.SourceString: 贺卡……前辈还为我准备了贺卡吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: A card... You even prepared a card for me?!

TextContext.SourceString: 如果里面写了前辈想和我说的话，那……也可以。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If it contains words you have for me, then... I'll allow it.
